experiment_data.hypothesis: C1 causal ablation at 30% sparsity (recommended operating point): BCE predictor trained on KL-derived oracle masks should achieve similar PPL and downstream metrics as the KL predictor at 30%, demonstrating that KL's advantage comes from mask quality (target effect) rather than gradient coupling.
